segments.text: Welcome aboard. Two ground rules first: we deploy behind feature flags, and every change needs a green CI before merge.

segments.question: Just to check it landed — what are the two ground rules I just mentioned?

segments.text: Good. Your first week, you'll pair with a buddy and ship one tiny doc fix end-to-end to learn the pipeline.

segments.question: What's the goal of that first-week tiny fix?
segments.target: to learn/practice the end-to-end pipeline (not the fix itself mattering)
